extracted.intended_audience: project developers, policymakers, researchers, donors, NGOs and civil society searching or filtering GEF project information
extracted.subtask_description: Use the GEF projects database page to find, filter, and export information about GEF-supported projects (by country, focal area, agency, funding source, status, etc.). The page provides facet filters, project listings, and CSV export for downstream use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country (National Projects)
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet listing national (country-level) projects with country names and project counts (e.g., Afghanistan (18), Albania (26), ... Zimbabwe (23)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this filter to restrict the project list to projects implemented at the national level in a given country; counts indicate number of matching projects. Multiple selections allowed to compare across countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country (Regional/Global Projects)
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet listing regional and global project coverage with locations and counts (e.g., Africa (26), Global (614), Regional (1001), specific countries with regional/global counts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this filter to select projects classified as regional or global, or regional groupings that include multiple countries; counts show matching projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Source
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet showing funding sources (e.g., CBIT Trust Fund, GEF Trust Fund, Global Biodiversity Framework Fund, Least Developed Countries Fund, Multi Trust Fund, NPIF, Special Climate Change Fund).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter projects by the GEF funding source used to finance them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-Grant Instrument
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet with options 'No' (6499) and 'Yes' (122) indicating whether the project uses a non-grant instrument.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter to include or exclude projects that use non-grant financial instruments (e.g., loans, guarantees).

rubrics_metrics.name: CBIT
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter projects that are associated with the Capacity-building Initiative for Transparency (CBIT).

rubrics_metrics.name: Focal Areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet listing GEF focal areas and project counts (e.g., Biodiversity (2469), Chemicals and Waste (788), Climate Change (2642), International Waters (533), Land Degradation (1042)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select one or more focal areas to narrow projects to relevant environmental themes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet listing implementing/partner agencies and counts (e.g., African Development Bank (76), Asian Development Bank (115), Food and Agriculture Organization (493), The World Bank (1052), UNDP (2797), UNEP (1400), UNIDO (486), WWF-US (79)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter projects by implementing agency or partner organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Type
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet listing project types and counts (e.g., Enabling Activity (1511), Full-size Project (3345), GBFF (82), Medium-size Project (1543), PFD (140)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to restrict results to a particular project modality or size/type used by GEF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet listing project lifecycle status with counts (e.g., Cancelled (241), Completed (3543), Concept Approved (348), Concept Proposed (25), Project Approved (2446), Received by GEF Secretariat (18)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter projects by current status to find active, approved, proposed, or completed projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval FY
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet showing approval fiscal years and counts (e.g., 2026 (111), 2025 (304), 2024 (184), ... back to 1991 etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter projects by the fiscal year in which they were approved.

rubrics_metrics.name: GEF Period
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet listing GEF replenishment periods or phases with counts (e.g., GEF - 1 (382), GEF - 2 (629), ... GEF - 8 (908), Pilot Phase (120)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restrict results to projects funded under a specific GEF replenishment period or pilot phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Displayed Project Columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Project listing columns shown in the results table: Title, ID, Countries, Focal Areas, Type, Agencies, GEF Grant, Cofinancing, Status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the key attributes available for each listed project; use them to scan project metadata and compare projects (e.g., grant amount, co-financing, implementing agency).

rubrics_metrics.name: Export data in CSV format / Download CSV
rubrics_metrics.description: Control to export the current project list to CSV ('Export data in CSV format', 'Download CSV').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to download the filtered project dataset for offline analysis, reporting, or integration with other tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter / Reset All Facets
rubrics_metrics.description: Interface controls to apply filters and to 'Reset all facets'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply multiple facet selections to narrow results; use 'Reset all facets' to clear filters and return to the full listing.
